title: Blue Blood: A mystery/puzzle visual novel game
author: Ready_Invite_6002
selftext:
# Blue Blood

*A fantasy mystery visual novel about memory, identity, and the price of freedom.*

You wake up in the mysterious kingdom of Bahara with no memory of who you are—or how you got there.

In a city struggling against a rising sea, you meet a sharp-tongued boatman, a mysterious royal, and a cast of unlikely companions. But beneath Bahara's beautiful canals lies a history someone desperately wants forgotten.

Uncover buried secrets, navigate a divided kingdom, forge friendships, and make choices that will shape the future of Bahara—and your own.

**The sea remembers everything. Even what you've forgotten.**

Featuring branching choices, mystery, humour, heartfelt moments, a little romance, terrible poetry, and one very troublesome cat.  
  
You can play the game here:

  
[https://claude.ai/artifact/1qHEZoRKG5fzEb9z2E97XJ](https://claude.ai/artifact/1qHEZoRKG5fzEb9z2E97XJ)

  
EVERYTHING EXCEPT the terrible poetry, lyrics, story and writing was made with generative AI. 

This is a completely self-indulgent project for me. I hope you enjoy it.
